acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p pkix-path --all-features -- tests_policy_fields exits 0 with all 4 require_san tests passing. Test 4 specifically verifies the i==0 guard by using a SAN-less intermediate.
close_reason: 4 require_subject_alt_name tests including i==0 guard regression test. All pass.
description:
**What:** Add unit tests for the `require_subject_alt_name` policy field in `pkix-path`.

**Algorithm:**
Tests go in `mod tests_policy_fields` in `pkix-path/src/lib.rs`.

**Test 1: `require_san_passes_when_san_present`**
- Chain: root-p256 → int-p256 → leaf-p256-365d-san-eku (has SAN: DNS:test.example.com)
- Policy: `require_subject_alt_name = true`
- Assert: `result.is_ok()`

**Test 2: `require_san_fails_when_san_absent`**
- Chain: root-p256 → int-p256 → leaf-p256-365d-no-san (no SAN extension)
- Policy: `require_subject_alt_name = true`
- Oracle: Leaf has no SAN → `MissingSan`.
- Assert: `matches!(result, Err(Error::MissingSan))`

**Test 3: `require_san_false_does_not_fail_on_missing_san`**
- Chain: root-p256 → int-p256 → leaf-p256-365d-no-san (no SAN)
- Policy: `require_subject_alt_name = false` (default)
- Assert: `result.is_ok()` — when false, missing SAN is not an error.

**Test 4: `require_san_only_checks_leaf_not_intermediates`**
- This is an important semantic test. Intermediates (CA certs) typically have no SAN.
- The existing `int-p256.der` fixture was generated WITHOUT a SAN extension.
- Chain: root-p256 → int-p256 → leaf-p256-365d-san-eku
- Policy: `require_subject_alt_name = true`
- Assert: `result.is_ok()` — the policy only checks the leaf (i == 0), so the SAN-less intermediate must not cause failure.

**Defensive programming rules:**
- Test 4 is the regression-protection test for the `i == 0` guard.
- `matches!(result, Err(Error::MissingSan))` — no fields on this variant.
- No `unwrap()` on the success cases.

**Subagent instructions:**
- Spawn one research subagent: confirm that `int-p256.der` does NOT have a SAN extension (run `openssl x509 -inform DER -in int-p256.der -text -noout | grep -i 'subject alt'` and confirm absence).
- Spawn one implementation subagent: write all 4 tests.
- Spawn one validation subagent: `cargo test -p pkix-path --all-features -- tests_policy_fields::require_san 2>&1`. All 4 must pass.

**Tests:**
| Name | Condition | Oracle | Assertion |
|---|---|---|---|
| passes with SAN | leaf has SAN, policy=true | Extension present | `is_ok()` |
| fails without SAN | leaf no SAN, policy=true | Extension absent | `Err(MissingSan)` |
| false skips check | leaf no SAN, policy=false | default behavior | `is_ok()` |
| only checks leaf | int has no SAN, policy=true | i==0 guard | `is_ok()` |
title: Tests: require_subject_alt_name enforcement
